summary: New glirastes/server/node: createNodeHandler bridges node:http-style servers (Express, Fastify, NestJS on Express) to the chat handler with bounded body reads, streaming with backpressure and abort on disconnect.
howTo: Replace a hand-written IncomingMessage/ServerResponse adapter with createNodeHandler(handler, { maxBodyBytes }) from glirastes/server/node. Keep maxBodyBytes at least the handler's and raise express.json's 100 kB limit (or leave express.json off the route). Pass origin for an HTTPS server or when the API runs elsewhere; the Request URL never comes from Host, and x-forwarded-* headers are dropped unless trustForwardedHeaders is set. Tested on node:http and Express 5; Fastify and NestJS are documented recipes. See docs/node-servers.md.
